applicable_domain: Wadeable to small alluvial stream reaches with a single-thread channel and unconsolidated floodplain sediment. Outside this domain, treat scores as indicative only.

exchange.notes: Monotone increasing in hyporheic connectivity (returning flux per stream mile). Knots are an order-of-magnitude ladder anchored on the Harvey et al. (2019) connectivity framing; values above 20/mi are flagged as extrapolation.

citations.title: How hydrologic connectivity regulates water quality in river corridors

storage.notes: Mobile pore-water storage divided by the reference plan area, i.e. an equivalent storage depth (m). Knots reflect the transition from negligible to substantial transient storage; values above 0.5 m are flagged.

processing.notes: Flux-weighted expected value of a continuous residence-time opportunity curve (0 at/below 1 h, a smooth log-time increase between 1 h and 1 day, plateau at/above 1 day). Not a universal nutrient-removal threshold.

evidence_notes: v1 knots are a documented starting point pending calibration against reference/restored sites, field exchange/RTD constraints, and grid/particle convergence. New evidence creates a new profile version; existing reports are not recomputed.
